label: Aruba CX 8360-48XT4C
description: Aruba CX 8360-48XT4C - 48x 1/10G 10GBASE-T RJ45 plus 4x 100G QSFP28 uplinks. L3 switch for 10G copper access.
notes: The 48 template ports are declared rj45 explicitly: at 10G both copper (10GBASE-T) and fibre (SFP+) are common, so the connector must not be guessed from the rate.
